{{Top|leg}}
A '''[[The Force/Legends|Force]] essence''' was the consciousness and self-awareness of a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] being. The [[Darkstaff]], a powerful [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]], desired to consume Force essences, and the artifact could also be used to remove Force essences from the bodies of individuals. In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] inadvertently caused the staff to rip the Force essences out of several of his slaves and to transfer the essences into a [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] pyramid.<ref name="AMA">{{LivingForce|A Mon Alone}}</ref>
